firm_data.firm_description: Potomac Law Group (PLG) is a law firm that provides legal services to companies of all sizes across all industries. It is known for its innovative business model and collaborative culture.
notable_facts: Attorneys have an average of 17 years of experience.
PLG represents nearly 20% of the Fortune 100.
The firm has offices in 25 states.
technology_signals: Uses latest technology to practice law in a low-overhead environment.

ai_contact.ai_notes: The Firm utilizes experience and technology in its representation and litigation strategies. In addition to cutting-edge legal research tools, the Firm has made significant investments in Artificial Intelligence technology. Our AI legal tools have improved the effectiveness of our professional staff while reducing costs associated with routine functions of legal representation.
